argv:
/system/bin/sh -c 'set -eu
p=853
row=$(cat /proc/$p/stat); rest=${row##*) }; set -- $rest; first=${20}
encoded=$(od -An -v -tx1 /proc/$p/environ)
printf '"'"'%s\n'"'"' "$encoded" | (key=; collecting=1; while read -r line; do for b in $line; do if [ "$b" = 00 ]; then key=; collecting=1; elif [ "$collecting" = 1 ]; then if [ "$b" = 3d ]; then printf '"'"'KEY_HEX=%s\n'"'"' "$key"; collecting=0; else key="$key$b"; fi; fi; done; done)
row=$(cat /proc/$p/stat); rest=${row##*) }; set -- $rest; test "${20}" = "$first"'; re_rc=$?; printf "\nRE_REMOTE_RC=%s\n" "$re_rc"
